releases.notes:
## Multi-Level Display v1.2.0

Switchable display layers for the Meteor Client modules GUI — now with per-category show/hide switches.

### Features
- Per-layer module visibility — each layer shows only the modules you pick
- One switch per category (at the category title): show/hide all its modules at once
- Layer switching automatically restores per-layer module states
- `.layer` command: next / prev / set / add / remove / rename / showall / list
- Layers persist to `meteor-client/layers.json`

### Downloads — pick the jar matching your Minecraft version

| File | Minecraft | Meteor Client |
|---|---|---|
| `multi_level_display-1.2.0-mc26.1.2.jar` | 26.1.x | 26.1.2-SNAPSHOT |
| `multi_level_display-1.2.0-mc26.2.jar` | 26.2 | 26.2-SNAPSHOT |
| `multi_level_display-1.2.0-mc1.21.11.jar` | 1.21.11 | 1.21.11-SNAPSHOT |

### Install
1. Install Fabric Loader + the matching Meteor Client build for your Minecraft version
2. Drop the matching jar into your `mods` folder
3. Press **Right Shift** in game — the **Layers** window appears at the top right

**Requires:** Java as required by your Minecraft version (21 for 1.21.11, 25 for 26.x)
